title: Kenny Chesney 2027 Tour: Get SiriusXM Presale Tickets
summary: Kenny Chesney’s The Original Vibe Room Tour 2027 also features Eric Church, Sheryl Crow, and Greylan James.
body_markdown:
[Kenny Chesney](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/no-shoes-radio) is hitting the road in 2027 for the Blue Chair Bay Rum Presents Kenny Chesney’s The Original Vibe Room Tour, also featuring[Eric Church](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/eric-church) ,[Sheryl Crow](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/sheryl-crow) , and Greylan James! SiriusXM listeners can access tickets in a special presale before they go on sale to the general public.


[No Shoes Radio Kenny Chesney’s channel Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogKCTourPresale)


### **Get Presale Tickets to See Kenny Chesney & Friends on the Original Vibe Room Tour**


#### **How to Get Presale Tickets**


SiriusXM listeners can access presale tickets beginning on Friday, September 19 at 10am local time through Thursday, September 24 at 10pm local time[here](https://www.ticketmaster.com/kenny-chesney-tickets/artist/767989) using code **SIRIUSXM** .


Tickets go on sale to the general public on Friday, September 25 at 10am local time.
